purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
assessment: Local land-office services and a city GIS portal are verified, but the GIS portal is login-gated. No anonymous full-polygon endpoint, safe field schema, or complete citywide cadastral coverage was verified.
registryAssessment: The Ipoh District and Land Office e-Tanah page documents the local land office and online services, and Ipoh City Council’s GIS page describes geospatial attribute-table data for the whole Ipoh area. The GIS page requires login; no anonymous cadastral layer or parcel-vector schema was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Ipoh City Council GIS page says the system contains geospatial data displayed through attribute tables for the whole Ipoh, Perak area and shows a LOGIN requirement. No login was used.
Perak e-Tanah page is specifically the Ipoh District and Land Office online-services page; it documents local land-office online services, not public vector geometry.
